title: How quickly must a P1 IT incident be resolved?

messages.content: How quickly must a P1 IT incident be resolved?

A P1 IT incident must be resolved within 4 hours. P1 incidents are considered critical and have specific response targets, which include acknowledgement within 15 minutes. If a P1 incident is not resolved within 2 hours, it is escalated to the Head of Infrastructure. The escalation procedure is in place to ensure timely resolution of critical incidents.

title: How often are full database backups taken?

messages.content: How often are full database backups taken?
Full database backups are taken nightly at 01:00 WIB. Full backups are also run every 6 hours.

sources.excerpt: Full backups run nightly at 01:00 WIB. Daily backups are retained for 30 days; monthly backups for 12 months.

messages.content: When must IT reoke a departing employee's access?
IT must revoke a departing employee's access within 2 hours of the employee's exit time. The exact time depends on when the employee's last working day ends.

sources.excerpt: Departing employees must return all company assets (laptop, access card, phone) on their last working day. IT revokes all system access within 2 hours of the employee's exit time.
